_comment: Database write policy. Copy to db-policy.json and edit for your machine.
db-policy.json is gitignored: it names YOUR databases, which is not information to publish.
The defaults below cover the standard TrinityCore schema names plus MySQL's own system
schemas. Add every other live database on your server to protectedSchemas.
IMPORTANT: this list is defence in depth, not the primary guard. The guard's core rule is
that any state-changing statement which does not explicitly name writableSchema is refused.
That holds even if protectedSchemas is empty, so an incomplete list does not open a hole -
it only costs you the clearer error message that names the schema you nearly hit.
